login.title: Welcome back

activate.title: Activate your account
activate.descriptionCode: Enter the invite code from your administrator.
activate.descriptionProfile: Confirm your mailbox, customize your profile, and choose a password.
activate.descriptionRecovery: Add a recovery email so you can regain access if you forget your password.

activate.profileHint: Add or update your details. Locked fields were set by your administrator.
activate.passwordHint: Use a long, unique password you don't use anywhere else.

bootstrap.title: Set up {{appName}}
bootstrap.description: Create the recovery account for this instance so you can sign in and configure everything else.
bootstrap.intro: This runs once after deploying a new instance. It creates a break-glass account (login: <login>{{login}}</login>) whose password is shown only at creation time — store it somewhere safe.
bootstrap.createdBody: Copy these credentials now — the password cannot be shown again.
bootstrap.existsBody: This instance already has a recovery account. Sign in with it, or regenerate its password from settings after signing in.

choose.title: Forgot password
choose.description: Choose how you'd like to reset your password.
choose.emailDescription: Send a reset code to your recovery email
choose.codeDescription: Use a reset code from your supervisor

email.title: Reset with email
email.hint: Use the mailbox address you sign in with.

noRecovery.title: Recovery email required
noRecovery.description: Self-service email reset isn't available for this account.
noRecovery.message: You haven't configured a recovery email. Please ask a supervisor for a recovery code.

code.title: Enter reset code
code.description: Enter the reset code you received.
code.label: Reset code
code.hint: Codes look like <example>AB2C-D4EF</example> and expire after a short time.
code.sentInfo: We sent a reset code to your recovery email. Enter it below to continue.

password.title: Choose new password
